samples.description: Common complete-case Table 2 firm-year sample for fiscal years 1988–2000 after the six-year history, best-effort M&A, auditor relationship duration, first-engagement-year, and annual outlier screens. Firm-year ratios retain native amounts when adjacent CURCD values match; unlike units use exact-date documented GBP cross-rates. Log assets and industry sales aggregates are in USD.

assumptions: OLS used as a best-effort choice because the source does not identify the Panel A estimator.
Uses local current-vintage COMP.FUNDA, its `che` field, and documented best-effort M&A proxy and S&P documented AU-code merger mapping.
Uses default model-based OLS standard errors because the covariance estimator is not reported.
Uses calendar year 2000 as the omitted year category to match Table 2 equation.

Uses native units for unit-invariant firm-year ratios when current/prior CURCD match; when codes differ, translates each stock at its own exact-date EXRATD and each flow at its own exact-date EXRAT12M using the Xpressfeed GBP cross-rate formula. Size uses USD assets and industry-year sales are aggregated in USD.

fits.blocked_reason: Stata 18 truncreg on the intended 16,114 positive discretionary-accrual observations produced no valid estimate. The ordinary full-model start and an intercept-only start exited r(1400), initial values not feasible. A full-length feasible OLS-based from() start then reached the full likelihood but exited r(430), cannot compute an improvement in a discontinuous region. Native NR, difficult, BFGS, DFP, and BHHH-to-NR starts were tried; a 100x outcome-scale diagnostic also failed before estimates. No coefficient or valid inference is reported. All observations remain in the analysis data.

limitations: The local Compustat file is a current vintage, not the paper’s 2001 annual industrial/research files; historical coverage/population equivalence is unverified.
Compustat M&A footnote codes are not present in the catalog; acquisition/merger financial fields are used as a proxy.
The local `che` label includes short-term investments, while the paper specifies cash and cash equivalents.
The paper does not specify annual percentile algorithm or the covariance estimator; SAS default percentiles and default model-based standard errors are used.
AU code 0 means unaudited and code 9 means other; neither identifies a specific auditor, so tenure and relationship duration are unavailable for those rows and they are excluded.
Auditor spells remain left- or right-censored at the observed COMP.FUNDA history boundaries; missing auditor codes and fiscal-year gaps break spells.

The local source uses COMP.FUNDA CURCD; same-currency scaled ratios remain native, cross-currency t/t−1 inputs use provider-documented GBP cross-rates, while log assets and industry-year sales totals are in USD. A matched daily rate has one blank EXRATTPD code; the positive rate is source-reported and unique, but its subtype is undocumented.

The M&A proxy uses nonzero financial items rather than the paper’s unavailable footnote codes; rows with all six proxy fields missing are not evidence of no M&A and are counted in the build log, but the inherited best-effort screen still cannot identify them.
Table 2 has no CRSP market-value input or fixed-dollar screening threshold; the paper’s Table 1 MVE descriptives are outside the assigned scopes.
